name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success | Onboarding, Training, Account Health Monitoring & Automation
summary: Customer success professional with 15+ years in client-facing SaaS roles, strongest in onboarding, training, and watching account health closely enough to act before problems surface. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye by monitoring utilization and acting on adoption gaps. Builds the automation flows, triggers, and dashboards that make account monitoring work at scale, in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Excel, and Power BI. Sold and scoped software for architecture and engineering firms at Accelo, with direct familiarity with how construction-adjacent teams work.
